rows.observation: 原文为“+25% spell critical chance”，译文“获得 25%法术暴击率”漏掉加号，可能把增益读成最终数值。
rows.conclusion: floor.lua:72 魔法大爆炸伤痕地面效果说明：+25% spell critical chance。译文“获得 25%法术暴击率”用“获得”表达增加，语义是增益而不是最终数值；与同句“增加 10%火焰和枯萎伤害”一样都是加成表述，没有把增益读成最终值的歧义。驳回。

rows.observation: 原文“20%%”和“1%%”的数字与百分号紧邻；译文写成“20 %%”和“1 %%”，格式化后会多出空格。
rows.conclusion: solipsism.lua:59-63 末行“增加 20 %%”“低于这个临界点 1 %%”“减少 1 %%”中数字与 %% 之间有空格，显示为“20 %”。%% 转义本身正确，不影响格式化与数值，只是与同条其他“%d%%”的排版不一致，属排版问题，记 advisory。

rows.observation: 原文“sunken lands off the coasts”指近海沉没的陆地，译文“海洋中沉没的大陆上”将其误写为大陆。
rows.conclusion: 固定 commit misc.lua:483-491 夏·图尔 lore：some have been observed in sunken lands off the coasts，指近海沉没的陆地。译文“有的废墟甚至位于海洋中沉没的大陆上”把 lands 说成“大陆”（整块大陆），还丢了 off the coasts（近海）的方位，夸大了设定。确认。修复建议：“有的废墟甚至位于近海沉没的陆地上”。

rows.observation: 原文“early attempts with questionable results”指早期尝试的结果存疑，译文写成“获得了一点可疑的结论”，将结果误作结论。
rows.conclusion: gates-of-morning-main.lua 太阳堡垒对话：Aside from a few early attempts with questionable results。译文“除了他早期的一些尝试获得了一点可疑的结论外”把“结果可疑”说成“结论可疑”，语义接近，不影响对白信息与任务理解，属二级措辞，记 advisory。

rows.observation: 原文“Neira’s eyes shot up”表示尼耶拉突然抬眼，译文写成“尼耶拉的眼神突然激动起来”，动作被误译为情绪变化。
rows.conclusion: elvala.lua 回忆录第三章：Neira’s eyes shot up（猛地抬眼）。译文“尼耶拉的眼神突然激动起来”把动作意译为情绪，但与下文她大声反驳的语境一致，没有改变情节，属二级措辞，记 advisory。

rows.observation: 末句“触发几率  在”及“几率  在”附近有明显多余空格。
rows.conclusion: 固定 commit timed_effects/other.lua:1477-1482 末句 The chance grows each time you are struck but fades over time. 译文“持续 8 回合。  触发几率  在每次你受到打击时提高”在“。”后与“几率”后各有两个多余空格，显示时出现明显断空，属格式缺陷（同类多余空格此前均按 confirmed 修复）。确认。修复：改为“持续 8 回合。触发几率在每次你受到打击时提高，同时随时间下降。”，其余不变。

rows.observation: 原文末句说传送距离随法术强度增加，译文写成“影响范围”，可能误指目标区域的半径。
rows.conclusion: 固定 commit spells/conveyance.lua（Phase Door）：getRange = combatLimit(combatTalentSpellDamage(t,10,15),…)，随法术强度提升的是传送距离 range；getRadius 只随技能等级变化，对应第 5 级的“半径 %d”。源文末句 The range will increase with your Spellpower 译作“影响范围受法术强度加成”，容易被理解为目标区域半径随法强提升，与实现不符。确认。修复：末句改为“传送距离受法术强度加成。”

rows.observation: 原文将回复力场每回合治疗的说明另起一段，译文将其并入上一段，少了一个换行及制表符。
rows.conclusion:
固定 commit spells/temporal.lua:79-82 源文四段，以 
		 分隔：第三段 Each turn the restoration field is active… 单独成段。译文把第三段并进第二段（“持续 5 回合，每回合回复……”），少了一处 
		，段落结构与原文不一致（换行不变量）。确认。修复：在“持续 5 回合。”后恢复 
		，第三段单独成句：“时间回复力场存在的每回合，你将回复总吸收伤害的 10%%（强化护盾技能会影响该系数）。”

rows.observation: 原文为尝试消除所有魔法效果和持续技能，译文额外限定“至多两项”，与原文相悖。
rows.conclusion: 固定 commit world-artifacts.lua:3909-3935 use 实现：对锥形内每个目标执行 for i = 1, 2 do … 随机移除一个魔法效果或持续技能 … end，最多驱散两项。源文 attempt to destroy all magic effects 与实现不符，译文“（至多两项）”如实反映了实现。按源码为准，驳回。

rows.observation: 译文增加了“生命值回满后结束该模式”，原文没有这一结束条件。
rows.conclusion: 公开 Orcs 源码 tome-orcs/data/timed_effects/other.lua AUTOMATED_REPAIR_SYSTEM（本批文件 SHA 匹配，DLC 仓库与 commit 未固定）：on_timeout 中 if self.life == self.max_life then self:removeEffect(self.EFF_AUTOMATED_REPAIR_SYSTEM) end，生命值回满时效果确实会结束。译文“生命值回满后结束该模式”与实现一致，不是无据增译。驳回。

rows.observation: 原文“every third hit always crits”指每第三次命中必定暴击；译文“每累计命中三次，下一次攻击”变成第四次攻击暴击。
rows.conclusion: 公开 Orcs 源码 tome-orcs/data/general/objects/world-artifacts.lua:1081-1090（本批文件 SHA 匹配，DLC 仓库/commit 未固定）：special_on_hit 在命中后累加 o.charge，达到 3 时把 o.combat.physcrit 设为 100 并清零计数，未满 3 次时设回 0。on_hit 在本次命中结算之后才执行，所以 100% 暴击作用于第三次命中之后的下一次攻击。译文“每累计命中三次，下一次攻击的物理暴击率变为 100%”贴合实现，驳回（源文“every third hit”与实现时序不一致）。

rows.observation: 译文“以至于 最多”在两个汉字之间多出一个空格。
rows.conclusion: 公开 Orcs 源码 tome-orcs/data/talents/steam/furnace.lua:171-176（文件 SHA 匹配，DLC 仓库/commit 未固定）：译文“温度极高，以至于 最多 %d 个负面物理状态被高温驱散”在“以至于”和“最多”之间多了一个半角空格，是可见的排版缺陷（同类多余空格此前均按 confirmed 修复）。确认。修复：删去该空格，其余不变。

rows.observation: 原文“anything written on those notes”指信上写的内容可能落到不希望其出现的地方，译文却写成“你写的每一封信”可能出现在那里，改变了所指对象。
rows.conclusion: 公开 Orcs 源码 tome-orcs/data/lore/misc.lua:87-95 邮递系统信件：Likewise, anything written on those notes could end up exactly where you don't want them。译文“你写的每一封信都有可能出现在你最不希望出现的地方”把“信上写的内容”说成“每一封信”，但丢信本身就意味着内容外泄，下文“写信时要想象托拉克国王在看”的告诫也完整保留，信息没有实质偏差，记 advisory。

rows.observation: 原文只说弹向“next closest foe”，译文增加“按与第一个目标的距离由近及远”，把选择下一目标的距离基准限定为第一个目标；冻结原文没有这个限定。
rows.conclusion: 公开 Orcs 源码 tome-orcs/data/talents/steam/gunslinging.lua（Trick Shot action，文件 SHA 匹配，DLC 仓库/commit 未固定）：x, y = main.x, main.y 取第一个目标坐标，逐个计算 dist = core.fov.distance(x, y, actor.x, actor.y)，只收 dist<=5 的敌人，再 table.sort(target_list, "dist")。弹射顺序确实按与第一个目标的距离由近及远排列，译文贴合实现，驳回。

rows.observation: 原文为160%奥术伤害，译文误写为130%。
rows.conclusion: 公开 Orcs 源码 tome-orcs/data/talents/uber/mag.lua（文件 SHA 匹配，DLC 仓库/commit 未固定）：奥术增幅无人机效果的实现在 :34 为 DamageType:get(DamageType.ARCANE).projector(self, a.x, a.y, DamageType.ARCANE, dam * 1.3)，实际波纹伤害是 130%。:82 描述写的 160% 与实现不符，译文“130%”贴合实际机制。按源码实现为准，驳回（不宜改回与实现矛盾的 160%）。

rows.observation: The target adds the clause「生命值回满后结束该模式」. Source text at other.lua:541 has no end-on-full-life condition, and the frozen snippet (538-544) shows no such logic, so this addition has no evidence. The clause also sits between the regen bonus and the resistance bonus, which breaks the source's enumeration of three effects. The host needs to check the effect's on_timeout/deactivate code to decide whether the clause should stay; if there is no such implementation, delete it.
rows.conclusion: 与 surface 同一指控。公开 Orcs 源码 tome-orcs/data/timed_effects/other.lua AUTOMATED_REPAIR_SYSTEM（文件 SHA 匹配，DLC 仓库/commit 未固定）的 on_timeout 中有 if self.life == self.max_life then self:removeEffect(self.EFF_AUTOMATED_REPAIR_SYSTEM) end。reviewer 未追到的 on_timeout 确实实现了“生命值回满时结束”，译文不是无据增译。驳回。

rows.observation: In the source, 'Furnace Vent' is a capitalized talent name from the same furnace.lua talent tree. The target renders it as the generic「通风孔效果」, so it no longer reads as that talent. The frozen terminology is empty, so there is no evidence for this talent's established translation; the host should check the name= translation for Furnace Vent and align it. The first line also has a stray space in「以至于 最多」.
rows.conclusion: 部分确认。关于技能名：本库 tome-orcs.lua:5001 t("Furnace Vent", "通风孔", "talent name")，译文“触发一次通风孔效果”已使用该技能的正式译名，这部分驳回。关于排版：“以至于 最多”之间多出的半角空格属实，与 surface 确认一致。修复：只删去该空格，技能名不改。

rows.observation: In the PS, 'No, the irony of that situation would not be lost on me' means the writer is well aware of the irony of this letter possibly falling into enemy hands. The target「不，别指望你能用这个场景的讽刺性来笑话我」turns it into 'don't expect to mock me with it', which is a semantic shift. It should say the writer is aware of or fully grasps the irony.
rows.conclusion: 公开 Orcs 源码 tome-orcs/data/lore/misc.lua 邮递信件末尾 PS（DLC 仓库/commit 未固定）：No, the irony of that situation would not be lost on me 意为“这其中的讽刺我心里清楚”，是 Yes/No 连答中写信人承认自己明白处境讽刺。译文“不，别指望你能用这个场景的讽刺性来笑话我”把它改成了警告对方别嘲笑，语义偏移，确认。修复：只改这一句为“不，这其中的讽刺意味我不会看不出来。”，前后各句不动。（surface 就“每一封信”的 advisory 维持不变。）

rows.observation: The source string at mag.lua:82 literally says '160% arcane damage', but the target says「130% 的奥术伤害」, so the number does not match. The frozen evidence has no code showing a 130% implementation, so the translation should say 160% to match the source text.
rows.conclusion: 与 surface 同一指控。公开 Orcs 源码 tome-orcs/data/talents/uber/mag.lua:34（文件 SHA 匹配，DLC 仓库/commit 未固定）的实现是 DamageType.ARCANE projector(..., dam * 1.3)，实际波纹伤害为 130%；:82 描述里的 160% 与实现矛盾。译文 130% 贴合实际机制，按源码实现为准驳回，不改回 160%。

notes: Fifth and final slice of the audit-merge successors: 55 entries (24 core game, 31 Orcs) in two surface groups of gpt-6-sol lanes (main game four lanes of 6, Orcs four lanes of 8/8/8/7). Lanes read or parsed only their own envelope and the contract; no Paseo terminal was created. The freeze reported one Orcs MISS: a DebugMain-section duplicate of the palace-fumes Steam Council lore missing the source's two trailing spaces (a dead key; the live row is the palace-fumes one).
Two contextual runs of claude/claude-opus-5-5 were accepted on the first pass: contextual-000 (main game, 9 deep entries) 9 OK; contextual-001 (Orcs, 6 deep entries) 2 OK, 4 ISSUE.

Confirmed: the Shasshhiy'Kaah lore overstates sunken lands as a continent and drops 'off the coasts'; the Retaliation-type effect text and the Furnace talent have stray spaces; Phase Door says the area grows with Spellpower although only the range does; the Temporal Restoration Field text merges two paragraphs; the farportal mail letter PS turns 'the irony would not be lost on me' into a warning not to mock the writer.

Refuted: the spell-crit ground effect is an increase; the Orcs artifact dispels at most two effects, charges crit on the hit after the third, and Trick Shot sorts by distance from the first target, all per implementation; the Automated Repair System does end at full life (on_timeout); the Arcane Amplification Drone ripple is 130% in code (dam * 1.3) though its description says 160%; Furnace Vent is the library talent name 通风孔.
Advisory: a %% spacing inconsistency, two second-tier wording choices, the 'every letter' paraphrase, and the Orcs DebugMain dead key.

All 55 entries were verified: the 24 main-game entries against the manifest-pinned engine commit 624a67329fe2ad440c5b344785a9c73fcf22ae63, and the 31 Orcs entries against public Orcs source whose file SHA-256 matched the extraction snapshot (DLC repository/commit not pinned). 1e08bd6f92 is an Orcs dead key (DebugMain section, missing the two trailing spaces of palace-fumes.lua:88); DLC snapshot identities cannot be host-blocked, so it was reviewed normally and recorded as advisory (batch 353 precedent).
6 confirmed repair revisions raise the window 53 backlog from 12 to 18; below the 20 threshold, so no window opens.
